title: DevExp Standup - 2026-06-24
content:
Attendees: Leah, Ethan, Maya, Ravi, Priya

TL;DR:
- Docs team shipped beta of the Quickstart guide for v0.9 SDK; feedback coming in from first 10 customers.
- SDK: telemetry bug identified causing duplicate events in low-traffic flows; fix in PR 412, targeting patch release tomorrow.
- Samples: added Chat + Function-calling sample; working on embedding similarity demo.
- Ops: coordinating with console team for the new 'example prompts' widget launch next week.

What we did last week:
- Leah: Polished quickstart flow, integrated code snippets for Python/TS, updated authentication section. Left TODOs for rate-limit guidance.
- Ethan: Implemented initial telemetry dedup logic, wrote unit tests. Opened PR 412 for review.
- Maya: Converted two notebooks into runnable samples (chat-with-tools, embeddings-retrieval). Started a small user study with internal PMs.
- Ravi: Drafted dashboard wireframes for sample usage metrics; synced with Console PM.
- Priya: Ran linter and accessibility checks over docs site; reported ~8 minor issues and one formatting regression on Windows.

Blockers / Risks:
- Telemetry duplication (Ethan): causes inflated event counts in low-volume orgs; affects cost analytics and rollout metrics. Blocker for GA of telemetry dashboard.
- Quickstart guidance: We still need clear SLO language for latency expectations on Hosted vs Dedicated - product review pending (linked Confluence page).
- Sample infra: current sample-run environment times out occasionally for embeddings demo. Might need increased timeout or small infra tweak.

Plan for next week:
- Leah: Add rate-limit guidance and minor security note; follow up with legal on recommended wording for key handling.
- Ethan: Merge PR 412 after one more review, cut v0.9.1 patch release, monitor telemetry for duplicates.
- Maya: Finalize embedding similarity demo and add a short walkthrough to samples/README. Run internal study and capture feedback.
- Ravi: Iterate on dashboard wireframes based on Console feedback; create proto tickets for frontend work.
- Priya: Re-run accessibility checks after docs merge; validate Windows formatting fix.

Action items (owners):
- Leah: File legal request for key handling guidance (by 2026-06-26).
- Ethan: Get +2 reviews on PR 412 and merge; publish patch release (by 2026-06-25).
- Maya: Publish embedding demo and attach internal-study notes (by 2026-06-30).
- Ravi: Create frontend tickets and share with Console PM (by 2026-06-28).
- Priya: Produce short checklist for docs contributors to avoid Windows formatting regressions (by 2026-06-27).

Notes / Decisions:
- Agreed to delay GA of telemetry dashboard until duplication bug confirmed resolved and 72h of stable telemetry is observed post-release.
- Decided not to add advanced batching examples to the quickstart; keep quickstart minimal and create an "Advanced Patterns" doc instead.

Follow-ups / References:
- PR for telemetry fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devexp-sdk/pull/412
- Quickstart draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/289
- Roadmap & product notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DEVEXP/pages/12345-DevExp-Roadmap

Notes to self:
- Collect example prompts from Solutions Engineering for the new examples widget - ask Sam and Ingrid for top 15 prompts.
- Consider a short video walkthrough for the quickstart after doc is stable.
